title: Advanced Reported Speech Formats
summary: Formal and news-style indirect reporting in Turkish.
explanation: News and formal media report statements using advanced nominalization and quotation markers like '-eceği belirtildi' or '...diye açıkladı'.
rules: Reported Clause + Formal Reporting Verb (diye / belirtti)
